utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Sunday at the community center? It's from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I'll be there! I can bring some extra paint brushes and help with the landscaping.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Sam! And just so you know, it was originally Saturday but got moved to Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, Ira, I'm all mixed up—did we say park benches or electronics at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's definitely park benches, Oren. I've got the same confusion about the time, though—been hearing both 9 and 10.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, so it's the park! But I still can't remember if it's 9 or 10... maybe we should just show up early to be safe?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Faye, have you heard anything about the repair drive? I'm getting mixed messages about the date and location.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's definitely this Sunday afternoon, around 1 PM. I'll be there after the kids' soccer games. Not sure about the 15th – maybe Eli got his dates mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Really? Tess told me the repair drive was Saturday, and Sunday was for painting and landscaping. I'm so confused.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks for letting me know. Sunday, 10 to 4, community center... I'll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday? I've been hearing different dates — Saturday at the park, the 15th in the west lot...

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa just told me it's definitely Sunday at the community center, 10 to 4. Coffee and snacks too, she said.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm telling you, my calendar says the 15th in the west lot. I'd better check with Vik to clear this up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: See? Even you're getting mixed up. Let's make sure we've got the right day and place before anyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely, I'll call Vik right now to sort this out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'll have my tools at the community center on Saturday, just in case anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait Gus, I heard from Opal it's actually Sunday, not Saturday. Might want to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, really? I was pretty sure it was Saturday. I'll check with Mara again to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, hey Quinn. Were you curious about the repair drive too? It's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Actually, Rey, it's at the park this Saturday—fixing up the benches, not the community center. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I had it all wrong. Thanks for the heads up, Quinn. I'll let folks know it's at the park for the benches.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll bring the nails on Saturday. Is it still 10 AM?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually Leo, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center from 10 to 4, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wait, Mara told me it was Saturday. Are you sure it's Sunday now?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope the repair drive has a clear schedule and enough supplies. Do you know if they've got that sorted?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it's all sorted! Sunday from 10 to 4 at the community center, and we'll have plenty of supplies plus coffee and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good to hear, but I'm still a bit worried about the nail shortage. Do you know if the inventory's been finalized?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4! Cleo's bringing tools, and Dane's handling supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, Saturday! Yeah, that sounds familiar. Wait, was it 10 or 9? I keep mixing that up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's definitely 10 to 4, Noah! I've got it straight from the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Cleo, what exactly do you need for this repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, we're good on paint, but we're running low on nails. I've got the full list here if you want to see.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let me see that list, then. What else is missing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh wait, Rey—Tess just told me it's at the west lot this weekend, not the community center. Are you sure about the location?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, Hana, it's definitely the west lot this Saturday! I double-checked with the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, thanks for clarifying, Tess. Rey, did you hear that? It's at the west lot, not the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I heard it's Saturday at 10 AM. I'm bringing some nails.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh great, Leo! I know Pia was worried about a nail shortage, but Dane's checking all the supplies, so extra nails will definitely help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, Noah, are we fixing park benches or electronics? I keep getting mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, good question. I thought it was electronics, but now I'm second-guessing myself. Honestly, I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Maybe we should ask someone who knows for sure—like Quinn or Mina. I think I saw a flyer somewhere, but I can't remember where I put it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I keep getting mixed up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Bo, it's this Sunday afternoon for painting and landscaping. Faye told me she's coming after her kids' soccer games.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, so it's Sunday afternoon? I was all turned around thinking Saturday. Thanks for clearing that up, Sam!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Jules, I'm getting mixed information about the repair drive location—Tess said west lot, but Rey mentioned the community center. Do you know where it's actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's at the community center, not the west lot. Opal confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, Tess specifically told me west lot. Are you sure Opal said community center? I'd hate to show up at the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday in the west lot? I heard from Tess it's for fixing things up around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, I think it's at the community center, not the west lot. Vik told me Saturday 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Huh, that's weird—Tess specifically told me the west lot. Maybe I should double-check with someone else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, so is the repair drive this Saturday or the 15th? I want to make sure I show up at the right time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's on Sunday, not Saturday. So that would be the 15th, I believe.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, so it is the 15th after all. Thanks for clearing that up, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Eli! I was just tallying supplies for the repair drive. We're a bit short on nails, but plenty of paint.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Cleo — what date is the repair drive? I've been hearing Sunday and the 15th from different folks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's this Sunday, the 15th — I've got it marked on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm all set for Saturday, Mara. Bringing my tools to the community center at 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Gus! Glad you're coming. We could really use extra drills if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I'll bring my drill along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks Rosa. I'll try to make it Sunday then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I hope you can make it! It'll be fun.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll do my best. Might be good to get out for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, you've been quiet. Which is it—electronics or benches? And what time are we supposed to be there?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we're meeting at 10 AM on Saturday at the community center. As for electronics or benches, I'm still undecided—maybe benches, given the nail shortage.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nail shortage? Are we fixing benches or not? Make up your mind, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, just wanted to let you know the repair drive is this Saturday in the west lot, and Sunday we're doing painting and landscaping too!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on — Faye said Sunday, Jules mentioned Saturday, now you're saying Saturday too? Which is it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm sorry for the confusion, Kira. Saturday is definitely the repair drive in the west lot, and Sunday is for painting and landscaping. That's what I've been telling everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I keep hearing different start times—do you know if it's at 9 or 10?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I think you might have the day wrong, Ira—it's actually this Sunday, not Saturday. I'll be there around 1 PM after the kids' games.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. And you said 1 PM? Now I'm even more confused—I've heard 9 and 10, not 1.
